name: MERGE_LEFT_YELLOW_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA101: W8-SA101B 750 x 500 illustrated (C 900 x 600, D 1200 x 800), R50, 10 / 30. MERGE '100 EM' (capitals in Series E modified) baseline 170, 510 (120/510/120); LEFT 100 EM baseline 315 (145 pitch), 365 (195/365/190); arrow 'W8-15' 400 long (175/400/175), centre line 105 from the bottom (y 395) — the AS 1743 W8-15 arrow pointing left (head 92 x 100, notch 9, shaft 29 to 39, R5), as a polygon. Sheet-vs-font: the sheet's MERGE 510 and LEFT 365 are wider than the FHWA Series E / E modified capitals at 100 (493 / 344; the national W8-15 gives MERGE 492) — the sheet's lettering is drawn wider (measured 502 / 360); font widths kept, each word centred on its stated position.
